picks.matchup: Las Vegas Raiders vs Houston Texans
picks.analysis: The Raiders are adjusting to their new head coach, which historically results in more competitive preseason games. With Jimmy Garoppolo leading drives and Houston's rookie QB still finding rhythm, Las Vegas can cover the slim spread.

picks.matchup: San Francisco 49ers vs Los Angeles Chargers
picks.analysis: Both teams boast deep receiving corps which should shine in this game as backups look to impress. Given Brandon Staley's aggressive playcalling style, expect some deep shots and touchdowns, pushing the game over the total.

picks.matchup: New York Jets vs Pittsburgh Steelers
picks.analysis: Jets' head coach Robert Saleh has infused competitive spirit in the team, and with recent acquisitions like Najee Harris, the Jets could keep it tight against the Steelers. The Jets' starters may see extended time compared to the conservative approach Mike Tomlin often takes in preseason.

The Panthers are aiming to find their identity under their new coaching setup led by Frank Reich. Their drive to establish momentum in preseason sets them up well against a Jaguars team likely managing snaps carefully post-playoff.
